VITTER LLC; JOHNSON FOODS, LLC; LP * IND., LLC; CAG HOLDINGS, LLC; * MAGISTRATE DONNA PHILLIPS RMH HOLDINGS, INC.; ABC * CURRAULT INSURANCE COMPANY and John * Does 1-4, * * Defendants. [PROPOSED] ORDER Before the Court is Defendants’ LP Ind., LLC (“LP”); CAG Holdings, LLC (“CAG”); RMH Holdings, Inc. (“RMH”); Martian Sales, Inc. (“Martion Sales”); Johnson Foods, LLC (“Johnson Foods”); JOpen, LLC (“JOpen”); Nuza, LLC (“Nuza”); Calibre Manufacturing, LLC (“Calibre”); FMK Group, Inc. (“FMK”); PNW Holdings, LLC; CC US Holdings, LLC (“PNW”); Peyton Palaio; Mark Jennings; David Gabbay; and Mark Reilly (collectively “Defendants”) Motion for Summary Judgment, as to all counts of Plaintiff’s Third Amended Complaint. Having considered the briefs, the arguments of counsel, and the evidence of record, the Court GRANTS Defendants’ Motion for Summary Judgment as to all counts of Plaintiff’s Third Amended Complaint. It is hereby ORDERED that: 1. Defendant’s Motion for Summary Judgment is GRANTED as to Plaintiff’s claims for design defect and failure to mark under the Louisiana Products Liability Act. 2. Plaintiff’s Third Amended Complaint is DISMISSED in its entirety. - 1
